id:
UX Studio has been updated and the custom login address you set up earlier is now really in force.

Log in here from now on:
%1$s

The usual address (wp-login.php) no longer shows the login form. Save the new address in your password manager.

If you do not want this, switch it off in UX Studio > Security > Login:
%2$s

If you cannot log in at all, add this line to wp-config.php and the old address works again:
define( 'UXSTUDIO_DISABLE_LOGIN_LOCK', true );
comments: #. translators: 1: new login address, 2: link to the setting.
